gunn_gran.text: Come in, come in, mind the cat. This house is Caithness flags from the floor to the roof, and it's been warm since my grandfather's day. Stone holds the heat, you see.
We were Gunns before we were anything. Clan Gunn, Norse blood from Orkney, and a feud with the Keiths that lasted longer than it had any right to.
Have a crowdie oatcake. No? You'll have had your tea. That's what we say. It's polite and it's a lie.
